documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report for the October 7, 2024 Planning Commission site plan review of the Joy Property automobile service garage at 7306 Springfield Ave. Three parcels: 0001 (B-L), Dinky Line, and 4088 (R-10,000). Staff recommends approval with conditions on parking space relocation and additional fencing.

documents.name: Site Plan
documents.synopsis: Revised site plan for 7306 Springfield Ave (Joy Property automobile service garage), showing the layout across three parcels with 9 parking spaces and screening.

documents.name: Staff Report
documents.synopsis: Staff report for the October 7, 2024 Planning Commission informational update on Parkside stormwater management remediation and Enclave at Parkside (P-23-0026) preliminary plan progress. No PC action requested.

documents.name: October 2024 Preliminary Plan
documents.synopsis: October 2024 preliminary plan for the Enclave at Parkside subdivision (P-23-0026, PEC zone, Parcel 688/689), submitted for informational PC review.

documents.name: Staff Comment Response Letter
documents.synopsis: February 5, 2024 letter from Morris & Ritchie Associates (engineer for Elm Street Development) responding point-by-point to Town staff comments on the Enclave at Parkside preliminary plan (P-23-0026). Addresses commercial use phasing, side yard setbacks, parking notes, speed limit, erosion/sediment control, sidewalk additions, and trail connection feasibility.

documents.name: Agenda
documents.synopsis: Planning Commission agenda for October 7, 2024. Three business items: Local Motive bar expansion site plan (7540 Main St), Joy Property automobile service garage site plan (7306 Springfield Ave), and Enclave at Parkside development informational update.

documents.name: Planning Commission Minutes - 2024-10-07
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the October 7, 2024 Sykesville Planning Commission meeting. Local Motive expansion at 7540 Main Street approved unanimously with parking waiver. 7306 Springfield Avenue site plan (Joy Property automobile service garage) approved unanimously conditional on screening fence at parcel 4088 parking. Enclave and Parkside development update (Jason Van Kirk, Elm Street Development): ~2,000 cf SWM deficit at Parkside being remediated via Enclave excess capacity; spring 2025 target for final Enclave approvals.
